title: melissa origanifolia
intro: Melissa origanifolia, commonly known as Lemon Balm, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of indigestion and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Lemon Balm include its calming and sedative effects, as well as its ability to soothe the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of Melissa origanifolia include rosmarinic acid, melissic acid, and citral, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
